D.t: Luke Bronin leads by 36.9 in the forecast and wins 100% of simulations. The cushion is about 108,240 votes; a one point swing is about 1,467 voters changing sides.
In 8 of 10 simulations the result lands between D +29.5 and D +43.9. Only an unusual polling error changes the winner.
$357K cash against $344. Spend it early on persuasion television in the battleground counties and keep a reserve for the last week.
